## About
Dr. Mahe's Dentistry is a modern, patient-centered dental studio in Porur, West Chennai. Founded by Dr. Maheswari (BDS), the clinic specializes in gentle, unhurried dental care for families. All instruments are sterilized using hospital-grade Class-B autoclave protocols. Digital X-rays reduce radiation by up to 90%. The clinic is open until 10 PM on weekdays for after-work and after-school appointments.

## Core Treatments
- [Painless Root Canal Treatment (RCT)](https://drmahesdentistry.in/root-canal) -- Single-sitting endodontic therapy
- [Dental Implants](https://drmahesdentistry.in/dental-implants) -- Biocompatible titanium tooth replacement
- [Orthodontics & Clear Aligners](https://drmahesdentistry.in/orthodontics) -- Ceramic braces, self-ligating & invisible aligners
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://drmahesdentistry.in/pediatric-dentistry) -- Gentle, fear-free kids dental care
- [Dental Crowns & Veneers](https://drmahesdentistry.in/crowns-veneers) -- Zirconia & e.max restorations
- [Oral Surgery & Wisdom Tooth Removal](https://drmahesdentistry.in/oral-surgery) -- Minimally invasive extractions
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://drmahesdentistry.in/cosmetic-dentistry) -- Smile makeovers & aesthetic care
